from the counter

What Moraima's does

Four things, done all day Tuesday through Saturday. Tap a card for the details.

All-Day Breakfast & LunchServed 8 to 3, Tue–Sat+
Breakfast Deluxe plates with pancakes or French toast, breakfast burritos, bagels, avocado toast, sandwiches like the Tripleta and the Bocadillo, quesadillas and a kids menu. The full list with prices is on the menu page.
Custom CakesMade to order, quoted per cake+
Tiered birthday cakes and themed builds like the ones in the gallery below. Custom work is quoted by the shop for your date and design, so start with the inquiry form further down or a call.
CoffeeCappuccino Boricua and more+
Americanos, cappuccinos including the Boricua, chai, dalgona and frozen coffees, frappes, and a long list of flavor add-ons. House coffee refills are fifty cents.
Party TraysQuesitos, strawberries, sweets+
Trays of quesitos, chocolate-covered strawberries and baked sweets for gatherings, ordered through the shop directly. Give them your date and headcount and they will build it.

Sage walls, tin ceiling, chalkboard menu

The dining room is part of the draw: green walls, striped awnings over the front windows, and the day's lineup lettered on the board. The mug on the table carries the same badge as this page.
